sara_p (product): Customer HealthCorp is asking for 8192-dim embeddings, batch ~512, and p50 <100ms. They want a migration plan and response format. Can we scope this for next quarter?

kevin (eng-platform): Realistically we can't do 8192x512 on our current hosted pool without sharding/streaming. Options: GA=4096, private beta 8192 on Dedicated, or server-side downsample/fallback. Also need batching-window limits tied to latency SLA.

li (eng-ml): Model note: rw-embed-large-8192 exists, but activation memory for big batches is the blocker. Quantization helps params but not activations. Suggest path: ship 4096 GA; offer opt-in async long-batch for 8192 on Dedicated.

mika (sdk): From SDK side we need a stable envelope. Recommend per-input objects and a header/field that indicates if client received full_dim. Also helpers to transparently handle fallback.

kevin (eng-platform): API contract sketch: keep outputs as array of {input_idx, embedding}. Add response headers: X-Embed-Dim, X-Embed-Full-Dim:true/false, X-Embed-Quantized:true/false. Clients can rely on same JSON shape across dims.

ops-bot: infra:scheduled: dedicated-capacity-smoke 2025-09-20T03:00:00Z.

kevin (eng-platform): Proposed launch criteria for 8192 beta: p50 <=150ms on 8xA100 for batch=256; p50 <=100ms for batch<=128 with batching_window <=20ms; 48h soak at 2x QPS with zero unrecoverable OOMs; fallback implemented and documented.

sara_p (product): Proposal accepted: prioritize GA 4096 this quarter, open private beta for 8192 on Dedicated (opt-in). I'll prepare customer comms and loop in sales for pricing.
